SELECT
FROM heartbeat_record WHERE device_id = #{deviceId} ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT t1.* FROM heartbeat_record t1 INNER JOIN ( SELECT device_id, MAX(timestamp) as max_timestamp FROM heartbeat_record GROUP BY device_id ) t2 ON t1.device_id = t2.device_id AND t1.timestamp = t2.max_timestamp ORDER BY t1.timestamp DESC

SELECT
FROM heartbeat_record WHERE device_id = #{deviceId} AND timestamp >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{hours} HOUR) ORDER BY timestamp DESC

SELECT
FROM heartbeat_record WHERE device_id = #{deviceId} AND DATE(timestamp) = CURDATE() ORDER BY timestamp DESC
SELECT ROUND( (COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(timestamp)) / #{days}) * 100, 2 ) as online_rate FROM heartbeat_record WHERE device_id = #{deviceId} AND timestamp >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY)

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(timestamp, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00') as hour, COUNT(*) as count FROM heartbeat_record WHERE device_id = #{deviceId} AND timestamp >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{hours} HOUR) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(timestamp, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00') ORDER BY hour DESC
